evidence.quote: the Committee today reaffirmed its view that the current 0 to 1/4 percent target range for the federal funds rate remains appropriate
The Committee anticipates that it will be appropriate to raise the target range for the federal funds rate when it has seen further improvement in the labor market
economic activity has been expanding moderately after having changed little during the first quarter. The pace of job gains picked up while the unemployment rate remained steady.
Inflation continued to run below the Committee's longer-run objective
The Committee continues to see the risks to the outlook for economic activity and the labor market as nearly balanced.
This policy, by keeping the Committee's holdings of longer-term securities at sizable levels, should help maintain accommodative financial conditions.

parsed.rationale: The statement holds rates at zero and keeps conditional liftoff guidance, with an improved activity and labor assessment offset by below-target inflation and low inflation compensation. Risks are described as nearly balanced and reinvestment continues, so the net signal is roughly neutral with a slight hawkish tilt from the stronger labor market.
